title: Answer
subtitle: 「答案／回答」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？
description: 「答案／回答」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？

words.note: 比 answer 稍正式，可指對問題、要求或情況作出的回應。
words.example: Her response to the question was clear and concise.

words.note: 特別常見於訊息、電郵、對話。
words.example: I sent her a message but received no reply.

words.note: 當 answer 指問題或難題的解法時，非常接近。
words.example: We finally found a solution to the problem.

words.note: 當 answer 是對 why / how 的完整說明時很接近。
words.example: The teacher gave a detailed explanation.

words.note: 較正式，常用於爭議、投訴、問題。
words.example: The talks produced a resolution to the dispute.

words.note: 在計算、測試或程序中，可接近 answer。
words.example: The final result of the calculation was 42.

words.note: 在研究、調查中可指所得答案／結論。
words.example: The study's main finding concerned sleep quality.

words.note: 經分析、思考後得出的最終判斷。
words.example: The committee reached a clear conclusion.

words.note: 快速、機智或幽默的回答。
words.example: She had a clever comeback for every criticism.

words.note: 尖銳、快速、有反駁意味的回答。
words.example: His angry retort ended the discussion.

words.note: 較正式／文學化，常見於辯論、評論。
words.example: She offered a brief rejoinder to his criticism.

words.note: 固定表達，表示帶不服從或不禮貌語氣地回答。
words.example: The child was told not to answer back.

falseSynonyms.zh: 反應不一定是語言回答。
